input.request: Build License Ledger, a direct content-licensing page. Token name: License Ledger. Token symbol: LICE. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. LicenseLedger lets a creator list a bytes32 work hash with a fixed LICE price and bytes32 terms hash; any buyer purchases one non-transferable license receipt, and the creator may deactivate future sales without affecting issued receipts. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a page to list works, buy licenses and verify receipts.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Constructors use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Creators list and deactivate their own work; buyers pay to obtain their own receipt, so all state transitions have a caller incentive.

draft.objective: Build and review LICE and LicenseLedger, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live content-license website.

steps.objective: Implement fixed-supply LICE and creator-owned license listings.
Test ownership, terms binding, exact price payment, receipt uniqueness, and deactivation.
Independently adversarially review the payment and receipt rules.
Build the live licensing page for listing, purchasing and verification.
